message: V_field says V_claimed, but recomputing from the IR gives V_actual
why: This field is derived, not authoritative. It is written at build time and must be recomputed on load — otherwise a tampered value would silently raise the execution ceiling, and bounds exist precisely to cap what a run may do.
fix: regenerate the artifact — the producer wrote an inconsistent value
if it was edited by hand, do not: derived fields are recomputed, not trusted
